title: Gatte Ki Sabzi
description: Rajasthani besan dumplings simmered in a tangy, spiced yogurt gravy.

ingredients.name: Curd
ingredients.notes: whisked, a little used in the dough

ingredients.name: Red Chilli Powder
ingredients.notes: 1 tsp for the dough, 1 tsp for the gravy

steps: Mix the besan with a few spoonfuls of the curd, the vegetable oil, carom seeds, half of the chilli powder, half the salt and a pinch of turmeric, and knead into a stiff dough with a little water.
Roll the dough into thin ropes and boil them in a pot of water for 10 minutes until they float; drain, keeping 1 cup of the water, and cut into 1-inch pieces.
Heat the ghee in a pan, add cumin seeds and hing, then the onion and cook until golden.
Add the ginger garlic paste, coriander powder, remaining turmeric and the remaining chilli powder and stir for 1 minute.
Lower the heat and stir in the remaining whisked curd gradually, cooking for 3-4 minutes so it does not curdle.
Add the reserved cooking water, the remaining salt and the gatte, and simmer for 10 minutes.
Finish with garam masala and coriander leaves.
